title: The shared part picker still searches, creates and saves normally on every host
custom_steps:
1. On WO Part dialog, estimate, part sale, tech charge-out row, New PO, PO item and vendor bill line: search and pick a part
  2. Type a new number → "Create … as a new part" (or special order on PO)
  3. Type a number and press Save at once
  4. Edit an existing line and save without changes
  5. Open a PO line with a locked description
  6. Open the WO Parts tab
custom_expected:
1. Pick works on every host
  2. New part / special order is created
  3. Saved number is not cut short (SV-9369)
  4. Saves with no error
  5. Description stays locked
  6. Loads with no "Failed to load part request data."
